description: Unlink an LMS course from one job. The link is retired with its history preserved for audit — nothing is deleted, and existing assignments keep their immutable course, progress, and event history. Repeating an unlink converges. Requires confirmUnlink=true (explicit acknowledgement of a live shared-state change) and an idempotency key. Requires lms:write.

idempotencyKey.description: Durable-receipt idempotency key: 8-128 characters of letters, digits, dot, underscore, dash, or colon. Same key + same payload replays the stored receipt; same key + changed payload is a 409.

name: opentrain_lms_unlink_job_course
